question: Should this stacked branch land as the combined publisher follow/feed feature, or should maintainers require the base API, controls, notifications, and feed routes to land as separate reviewed slices?
rationale: The branch is a new product/API surface with persistent user state and multiple open dependent PRs; automation can identify blockers, but maintainers need to choose the intended stack and public contract boundary.

options.title: Split or restack first
options.body: Require the base follow API, follow controls, notifications, and feed routes to clear proof and review in order before this top-of-stack branch is considered.

options.title: Review as one stack
options.body: Treat this PR as the combined feature branch, but require maintainers to own the larger API, data model, and runtime proof surface before merge.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Leave the draft parked until the publisher feed/follow contract and release order are explicitly sponsored.

recommendation.title: Split or restack first
recommendation.body: Require the base follow API, follow controls, notifications, and feed routes to clear proof and review in order before this top-of-stack branch is considered.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal is in the route/schema package and publisher profile baseline that this PR extends.
